import zlib,struct
d=open('spec.png','rb').read()
p=8;idat=b''
while p<len(d):
    l,t=struct.unpack('>I4s',d[p:p+8]);c=d[p+8:p+8+l]
    if t==b'IDAT':idat+=c
    p+=12+l
raw=zlib.decompress(idat);W,H,bpp=244,32,3;s=W*bpp
rows=[];prev=bytearray(s);i=0
for y in range(H):
    f=raw[i];line=bytearray(raw[i+1:i+1+s]);i+=1+s
    for x in range(s):
        a=line[x-bpp] if x>=bpp else 0;b=prev[x];c=prev[x-bpp] if x>=bpp else 0
        if f==1:line[x]=(line[x]+a)&255
        elif f==2:line[x]=(line[x]+b)&255
        elif f==3:line[x]=(line[x]+(a+b)//2)&255
        elif f==4:
            pa=abs(b-c);pb=abs(a-c);pc=abs(a+b-2*c)
            pr=a if pa<=pb and pa<=pc else (b if pb<=pc else c)
            line[x]=(line[x]+pr)&255
    rows.append(line);prev=line
bg=rows[0][:3]
for y in range(2,30,4):
    print(''.join('#' if abs(rows[y][x*3]-bg[0])+abs(rows[y][x*3+1]-bg[1])+abs(rows[y][x*3+2]-bg[2])>150 else '.' for x in range(150,244,2)))
